sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A REX BLOCK...CURRENTLY EXTENDING FROM THE NERN PACIFIC INTO ALASKA PER WATER VAPOR IMAGERY...WILL PERSIST THROUGH THE DAY 1 FORECAST PERIOD...WITH A SMALL EWD SHIFT OF THE CLOSED LOW TOWARD THE BRITISH COLUMBIA AND WA/ORE COASTS. GRADUAL DOWNSTREAM HEIGHT RISES IN THE NRN ROCKIES AND A SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVING SWD ACROSS ERN HUDSON BAY SHOULD RESULT IN SLIGHT AMPLIFICATION OF MID-UPPER LEVEL FLOW ACROSS THE NRN TIER STATES. A BROAD CYCLONIC FLOW REGIME WILL EXTEND FROM THE NRN PLAINS THROUGH THE GREAT LAKES TO THE NERN STATES...WITH A PRAIRIE PROVINCES SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVING INTO ND THIS AFTERNOON AND REACHING MN SUNDAY NIGHT. A MIDLEVEL IMPULSE EMANATING FROM THE GREAT BASIN IS EXPECTED TO MOVE THROUGH THE RIDGE IN CO REACHING KS THIS EVENING. A WEAKENING COLD FRONT SHOULD CROSS THE GREAT LAKES...WITH TRAILING PORTION REMAINING QUASI-STATIONARY AND GENERALLY W/E-ORIENTED OVER FAR NRN KS. OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES WILL LIKELY BE PRESENT S OF THE FRONTAL ZONE IN THE WAKE OF OVERNIGHT SATURDAY/EARLY SUNDAY MORNING TSTMS FROM PARTS OF THE OH VALLEY TO KS/OK. A SECOND FRONT ATTENDANT TO THE PRAIRIE PROVINCES SHORTWAVE TROUGH WILL ADVANCE SEWD THROUGH THE DAKOTAS AND MN.

sections.title: CENTRAL AND SRN PLAINS
sections.text: THE ONGOING CLUSTER OF STORMS IN WRN KS IS EXPECTED TO HAVE EXITED KS INTO PARTS OF OK BY 12Z TODAY...WHILE ADDITIONAL STORMS MAY BE ONGOING AT THE START OF DAY 1 FROM ERN KS INTO THE LOWER MO VALLEY. THIS WILL ALLOW FOR SUFFICIENT SURFACE HEATING OF A MOIST WARM SECTOR BENEATH STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES RESULTING IN MODERATE TO STRONG INSTABILITY. ALTHOUGH THIS REGION WILL RESIDE SOUTH OF STRONG MIDLEVEL WINDS...MODEST WLY FLOW ALOFT ATOP E/SELY LOW LEVEL WINDS WILL RESULT IN EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 40-50 KT THROUGH THE FORECAST PERIOD. INITIAL TSTM DEVELOPMENT SHOULD OCCUR WITHIN UPSLOPE FLOW IN THE CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS AND POSSIBLY ALONG THE W-E ORIENTED BOUNDARY IN NRN KS. SUPERCELLS WILL BE LIKELY WITH HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS THE INITIAL THREATS...WITH SOME OF THE HAIL VERY LARGE OVER NRN KS/SRN NEB WHERE INSTABILITY SHOULD BE THE STRONGEST. A FEW TORNADOES WILL BE POSSIBLE AT THE INTERSECTION OF THE W-E ORIENTED FRONT AND A LEE TROUGH WHERE LOW LEVEL SHEAR WILL BE ENHANCED IN NWRN KS. THIS THREAT SHOULD DEVELOP/SPREAD SEWD INTO CENTRAL/SRN KS AS LOW LEVEL SHEAR/HODOGRAPH CURVATURE INCREASES ALONG A STRENGTHENING SLY LLJ. INCREASING LOW LEVEL WAA ALONG THE LLJ AND FORCING FOR A

sections.title: SRN/ERN SD INTO WRN/CENTRAL MN
sections.text: A RELATIVELY NARROW PLUME OF MOISTURE RETURN IS EXPECTED INTO SRN/ERN SD TO PARTS OF WRN/CENTRAL MN IN ADVANCE OF THE SEWD MOVING COLD FRONT. DESPITE SURFACE HEATING IN THESE AREAS...LIMITED MOISTURE RETURN SUGGESTS MLCAPE WILL RANGE FROM 500-1000 J/KG BY PEAK HEATING. STRONGEST FORCING FOR ASCENT WITH THE PRAIRIE PROVINCE SHORTWAVE TROUGH IS NOT EXPECTED TO REACH SRN/ERN SD INTO CENTRAL MN UNTIL AFTER 00Z. THIS COMBINED WITH THE MODEST DESTABILIZATION SUGGESTS TSTM DEVELOPMENT AND ANY SEVERE STORM COVERAGE COULD REMAIN LIMITED. THUS...THIS OUTLOOK WILL MAINTAIN LOW SEVERE PROBABILITIES INTO THESE AREAS. ...MID MS AND OH VALLEYS TO MID ATLANTIC AND NERN STATES.. TSTMS AND/OR REMNANT SHOWERS ARE EXPECTED TO BE ONGOING FROM THE MID MS VALLEY THROUGH THE OH VALLEY TO LOWER GREAT LAKES...WITHIN A BROAD LOW LEVEL WAA REGIME. POOR MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND EXTENSIVE CLOUDINESS SHOULD LIMIT INSTABILITY...BUT WHERE SURFACE HEATING CAN OCCUR...IT MAY YIELD WEAK DESTABILIZATION DURING THE DAY. MODERATELY STRONG UNIDIRECTIONAL FLOW FIELDS MAY SUPPORT A MARGINAL SEVERE THREAT DEVELOPING E OF THE NRN/CNTRL APPALACHIANS WHERE SLY LOW LEVEL MOISTURE ADVECTION...INTO AT LEAST THE MID ATLANTIC STAT

sections.title: MID SOUTH TO SRN APPALACHIANS
sections.text: CURRENT WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SHOWED A COUPLE OF MIDLEVEL IMPULSES MOVING EWD THROUGH THE ARKLATEX REGION AND OZARKS. THESE FEATURES ARE EXPECTED TO SHIFT EWD THROUGH THE MID SOUTH WHERE THE ENVIRONMENT WILL BE MOISTENING. THIS IN COMBINATION WITH SURFACE HEATING SHOULD RESULT IN A MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS AND THE DEVELOPMENT OF AFTERNOON TSTMS AS FORCING FOR ASCENT WITH THE IMPULSES SPREADS EWD. DESPITE WEAK LOWER TROPOSPHERIC WINDS...ENHANCED WLY MIDLEVEL WINDS ACCOMPANYING THE IMPULSES SHOULD RESULT IN EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 25-35 KT SUPPORTING MULTICELLS AND A FEW SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING ISOLATED HAIL AND STRONG WIND GUSTS. GIVEN SOME UNCERTAINTY IN THE OVERALL DEGREE OF FORCING ALOFT...THIS OUTLOOK WILL ONLY INTRODUCE LOW SEVERE WIND/HAIL PROBABILITIES. ..PETERS/ROGERS.. 06/16/2013

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A LOW-AMPLITUDE BELT OF MODERATE MID-LEVEL WLY/S WILL EXTEND FROM THE NRN PLAINS TO THE NE STATES DOWNSTREAM OF A RIDGE OVER THE ROCKIES. ONE EMBEDDED SHORTWAVE TROUGH WILL ADVANCE FROM THE SRN CANADIAN PRAIRIE PROVINCES TO THE GREAT LAKES...WHILE A LEADING IMPULSE TRACKS FROM THE GREAT LAKES TO NEW BRUNSWICK. A WEAK SFC COLD FRONT ACCOMPANYING THE LATTER FEATURE WILL TRACK FROM LOWER MI TO NEW ENGLAND BEFORE MOVING OFFSHORE TONIGHT. THE FRONT WILL TRAIL WWD OVER THE SRN FRINGES OF THE MODERATE WLY/S INTO THE CNTRL PLAINS. AS SFC PRESSURE FALLS COMMENCE OVER PARTS OF THE NRN PLAINS...THIS FRONT WILL ADVANCE NWD AS A WEAKENING WARM FRONT ACROSS PARTS OF NEB. MEANWHILE...A DEWPOINT GRADIENT WILL SHARPEN THIS AFTERNOON INVOF A STRENGTHENING LEE TROUGH THAT WILL EXTEND N/S OVER THE CNTRL/SRN HIGH PLAINS.

sections.title: PORTIONS OF THE CNTRL/SRN GREAT PLAINS FOR TODAY INTO TONIGHT
sections.text: THE AIR MASS WILL BECOME MODERATELY TO STRONGLY UNSTABLE S OF THE WEAKENING WARM FRONT AND E OF THE LEE TROUGH THIS AFTERNOON AS STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES ARE MAINTAINED BY THE INFLUX OF AN EML. MODIFIED 12Z RAOBS SUGGEST THAT MLCAPE VALUES ARE EXPECTED TO REACH AROUND 1500-3500 J/KG THIS AFTERNOON AS DIURNAL HEATING OCCURS AMIDST MIDDLE 60S TO LOWER 70S SFC DEWPOINTS. A FEW SCENARIOS FOR THUNDERSTORM AND ASSOCIATED SVR POTENTIAL FOLLOW: /1/ THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP BY MID AFTERNOON OVER THE CO ROCKIES AS OROGRAPHIC CIRCULATIONS STRENGTHEN THROUGH THE DAY...WITH ADDITIONAL STORM DEVELOPMENT OCCURRING ALONG THE LEE TROUGH THIS AFTERNOON. AS THIS ACTIVITY IS STEERED ESEWD INTO THE MORE BUOYANT AIR LYING E OF THE LEE TROUGH...IT SHOULD INTENSIFY WHILE POTENTIALLY CONGEALING INTO ONE OR MORE MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE SYSTEMS LATE THIS AFTERNOON INTO THIS EVENING. SVR HAIL/WINDS WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THIS ACTIVITY...WITH THE GREATEST POTENTIAL FOR SVR HAIL INVOF A LOW-LEVEL MOIST AXIS EXTENDING INTO SWRN NEB...NWRN KS...AND NERN CO. SVR WINDS WILL BECOME OF INCREASING CONCERN AS CONVECTION POTENTIALLY GROWS UPSCALE ACROSS PORTIONS OF CNTRL/SRN KS...WITH THIS ACTIVITY PERHAPS S

sections.title: EAST OF THE MISSISSIPPI RIVER FOR TODAY INTO THIS EVENING
sections.text: THE FRONTAL ZONE WILL BE THE FOCUS FOR SHOWERS/STORMS THROUGH THE PERIOD. WIDESPREAD CONVECTIVE DEBRIS EXTENDS FROM THE MID-MS VALLEY TO THE NJ COAST ON THE WARM SIDE OF THIS BOUNDARY...PARTLY IN ASSOCIATION WITH A SUBTLE SHORTWAVE DISTURBANCE BEING ABSORBED INTO THE ZONE OF MODERATE WLY/S. THIS WILL LARGELY RESTRICT INSOLATION/DIABATIC HEATING IN AREAS WHERE MID-LEVEL FLOW IS ENHANCED BY THE DISTURBANCE. FURTHERMORE...SFC OBSERVATIONS AND 12Z RAOBS SUGGEST THAT THE BOUNDARY LAYER WILL NOT BECOME PARTICULARLY MOIST/UNSTABLE IN AREAS WHERE KINEMATIC PROFILES WOULD OTHERWISE SUPPORT FAST...EWD-MOVING CONVECTIVE CLUSTERS WITH SVR WIND GUSTS -- I.E. FROM PARTS OF NERN WV TO S-CNTRL PA EWD TO THE DELMARVA AND SRN NJ. WHILE SOMEWHAT GREATER INSTABILITY MAY OCCUR S OF THE MORE DENSE MULTI-LAYERED CLOUD DECK -- I.E. ACROSS PARTS OF KY AND SRN VA SWWD INTO NRN MS -- WEAKER TROPOSPHERIC FLOW IN THESE AREAS SHOULD LIMIT THE SVR POTENTIAL. ..COHEN/MEAD.. 06/16/2013

sections.title: NEB TO OK AND THE TX PANHANDLE THROUGH TONIGHT
sections.text: THE PRIMARY JET IS LOCATED FROM THE NRN PLAINS TO THE GREAT LAKES AND NEW ENGLAND...WITH THE PRIMARY ASSOCIATED FRONTAL ZONE FROM THE LOWER GREAT LAKES WWD TO NEB. S OF THE MAIN JET...LOW-AMPLITUDE WAVES CONTINUE TO MOVE NEWD FROM THE GREAT BASIN TO THE HIGH PLAINS...AND THEN ESEWD TOWARD THE MS/OH VALLEYS. ONE SUCH WAVE APPEARS TO BE MOVING FROM ERN WY TO SW SD/NW NEB AS OF MID MORNING...AND IS ASSOCIATED WITH A CLUSTER OF ELEVATED STORMS IN A WEAK WAA REGIME. ONCE THE BOUNDARY LAYER WARMS INTO THE 75-80 F RANGE TO THE S-SW OF THE ONGOING STORMS...CONVECTIVE INHIBITION WILL BE LARGELY REMOVED AND THE CONVECTION SHOULD BECOME ROOTED AT THE SURFACE. SUPERCELLS WITH LARGE HAIL/DAMAGING WINDS ARE EXPECTED INITIALLY GIVEN EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR NEAR 50 KT AND MLCAPE OF 2000-3000 J/KG. UPSCALE GROWTH INTO AN MCS APPEARS LIKELY LATER THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING AS STORM INTERACTIONS LEAD TO COLD POOL DEVELOPMENT IN NEB. ADDITIONALLY...A MIDLEVEL MOISTURE SURGE AND WEAK MIDLEVEL WAVE OVER NW CO COULD BE A PRECURSOR TO RELATIVELY EARLY CONVECTION THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS NE CO...WHICH WOULD SUPPORT ADDITIONAL COLD POOL DEVELOPMENT AND EVENTUAL INTERACTIONS WITH THE NEB CONVECTION. AS THE STORMS GROW

sections.text: A LOW-AMPLITUDE SPEED MAX IS MOVING EWD OVER THE OH VALLEY TOWARD THE MID ATLANTIC REGION. WIDESPREAD CLOUDS AND POOR LAPSE RATES...ALONG WITH RATHER MODEST LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE....WILL LIMIT BUOYANCY IN THE PRE-FRONTAL WARM SECTOR. THE BETTER CHANCE FOR STORMS WITH ISOLATED STRONG OUTFLOW WINDS WILL BE ALONG THE SRN FRINGE OF THE THICKER CLOUDS WHERE SURFACE HEATING IS GREATER...FROM KY TO VA...WHICH ALSO COINCIDES WITH THE SRN FRONT OF THE STRONGER MIDLEVEL FLOW. ..THOMPSON/GUYER.. 06/16/2013

sections.title: CENTRAL/SRN PLAINS
sections.text: EARLY EVENING RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED 3 CLUSTERS OF TSTMS OVER SOUTH CENTRAL NEB...NWRN KS AND WEST CENTRAL KS TO SERN CO...WHILE IR SATELLITE IMAGERY INDICATED COOLING CLOUD TOPS WITH EACH OF THESE CLUSTERS. FORECAST REMAINS ON TRACK FOR THESE CLUSTERS TO MERGE AND GROW UPSCALE INTO ONE OR MORE MCS/S THIS EVENING AND TRACK TOWARD THE S/SE ACROSS KS AND THE OK/NERN-ERN TX PANHANDLES AS A SLY LLJ EXTENDING FROM W TX INTO WRN KS STRENGTHENS TO 30-35 KT. THE SRN EXTENT OF THIS LLJ SHOULD VEER TO SWLY OVERNIGHT SUGGESTING THE SRN MCS WILL TRACK SEWD INTO OK LATE THIS EVENING THROUGH THE OVERNIGHT TO EARLY MONDAY MORNING. MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES NEAR 8 C/KM PER 00Z SOUNDINGS AT DDC/OUN/FWD...RESIDUAL MODERATE INSTABILITY AND AN INCREASE IN BULK SHEAR EXPECTED OVER KS TO N TX WILL PROVIDE THE THERMODYNAMICS AND KINEMATICS TO SUPPORT MCS/S THROUGH THIS FORECAST PERIOD. ANY BOWING STRUCTURES WILL POSE A DAMAGING WIND THREAT... WHILE HAIL ALSO REMAINS A THREAT. FARTHER S...THIS OUTLOOK HAS MAINTAINED A SLIGHT RISK FOR SEVERE STORMS INTO NWRN TX...AS THE ONGOING STRONG-SEVERE STORM HALL COUNTY COULD PERSIST THIS EVENING AS IT DEVELOPS SWD INTO THE STRENGTHENING SLY LLJ. HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS WIL

sections.title: NERN AL/NRN GA TO ERN KY/SRN WV/SWRN-SOUTH CENTRAL VA
sections.text: EARLY EVENING WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SHOWED A PAIR OF EWD MOVING MIDLEVEL IMPULSES...ONE OVER CENTRAL KY AND THE OTHER OVER NERN AL. OBJECTIVE ANALYSES INDICATED RESIDUAL MODERATE INSTABILITY EXTENDED FROM NERN AL/NRN GA THROUGH ERN TN...AND INTO PARTS OF ERN KY TO CENTRAL/SRN VA. GIVEN THIS INSTABILITY...FORCING FOR ASCENT ATTENDANT TO THE TWO IMPULSES SHOULD PROVE FAVORABLE IN SUPPORTING ADDITIONAL TSTM DEVELOPMENT ALONG THE TRACKS OF THESE MIDLEVEL FEATURES. UNIDIRECTIONAL WLY WIND FIELDS WITH 25-30 KT OF MIDLEVEL WINDS ENHANCING BULK SHEAR SUGGEST A FEW STRONG TO PERHAPS SEVERE STORMS REMAIN POSSIBLE THIS EVENING...PRIOR TO AN INCREASE IN SURFACE BASED INHIBITION WITH THE LOSS OF DAY TIME HEATING. ..PETERS.. 06/17/2013

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS ARE FORECAST TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE AND INTENSIFY OVER SWRN SD AND WRN NEB THIS AFTERNOON. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE. WW WILL BE ISSUED DURING THE NEXT ONE TO TWO HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MAINLY ELEVATED THUNDERSTORMS HAVE BEEN OCCURRING OVER SWRN SD INTO PORTIONS OF WRN/CNTRL NEB DURING THE MORNING. MOST OF THIS ACTIVITY IS BEGINNING TO DRIFT EWD AND WEAKEN AS IT ENCOUNTERS A DIVERGENT LOW-LEVEL FLOW REGIME. HOWEVER...OUTFLOW HAS BEEN LAID OUT IN A NNW-SSE ORIENTATION OVER WRN NEB...WITH ANOTHER AREA OF OUTFLOW SURGING SWD OVER SWRN SD. IN ADDITION...SURFACE WINDS HAVE VEERED TO SWLY OVER THE NEB PANHANDLE...WHICH IS AIDING IN AN ENHANCED ZONE OF CONVERGENCE OVER ALONG AND W OF THE OUTFLOW. MODIFYING THE 12Z LBF RAOB FOR CURRENT TEMPERATURES IN THE UPPER 70S/LOW 80S...AND DEWPOINTS IN THE MID TO UPPER 50S YIELDS MLCINH NEAR 0 J/KG AND MLCAPE VALUES APPROACHING 2500-3000 J/KG. THUS...ENVIRONMENT APPEARS FAVORABLE FOR SURFACE BASED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT. TWO SCENARIOS APPEAR POSSIBLE THIS AFTERNOON. STORMS COULD EITHER FORM ALONG THE OUTFLOW SURGING S OVER SWRN SD INTO NWRN NEB...AND THEN CONTINUE PROPAGATING SWD ACROSS WRN NEB...OR...STORMS COULD FORM WITHIN A PLUME OF ASCENT/ELEVATED MOISTURE SPREADING NEWD OUT OF CO WITH THUNDERSTORM INTENSIFICATION TAKING PLACE AS GREATER MOISTURE/CAPE IS ENCOUNTERED OVER WRN NEB. ONCE THUNDERSTORMS DO DEVELOP...LOW-LEVEL SELYS VEERING TO WLY IN THE MID/UPPER LEVELS /WHERE SPEEDS EXCEED 30+ KT/ COMBINED WITH STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES AND MODERATE TO STRONG BUOYANCY WILL FAVOR SUPERCELLS POSING A LARGE HAIL/DAMAGING WIND THREAT...AND PERHAPS AN ISOLATED TORNADO. ACTIVITY WILL EVENTUALLY MERGE AND GROW UPSCALE INTO AN MCS AS IT MOVES SEWD.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE POTENTIAL INCLUDING DAMAGING WINDS/BOUTS OF SEVERE HAIL SHOULD INCREASE THROUGH MID/LATE AFTERNOON WITHIN A CORRIDOR INCLUDING THE EASTERN TX PANHANDLE/FAR NORTH TX AND MUCH OF OK. ALTHOUGH THE EXTENT/MAGNITUDE OF THE SEVERE RISK IS A BIT UNCERTAIN...A SEVERE TSTM WATCH COULD BE NEEDED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A SMALL-SCALE/RELATIVELY SUBTLE MID-LEVEL TROUGH APPEARS TO TRANSITIONING EAST-SOUTHEASTWARD ACROSS THE OK/NORTHERN TX PANHANDLE VICINITY THIS AFTERNOON...WITH PERSISTENT WEAK ELEVATED CONVECTION SINCE THIS MORNING ACROSS THE NORTHEAST TX PANHANDLE/NORTHWEST OK. TO THE EAST-SOUTHEAST OF THIS ACTIVITY...EARLY DAY CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW CONTINUES TO MODIFY/BECOME MORE SUBTLE...ALTHOUGH A WEAK SURFACE LOW IS NOTED ACROSS WESTERN OK COINCIDENT WITH A CORRIDOR OF DIFFERENTIAL HEATING/MODEST MASS CONVERGENCE ACROSS WESTERN/PARTS OF CENTRAL OK. ADDITIONALLY...A DEEPENING CU FIELD IS NOTED ACROSS SOUTHEAST OK ALONG/JUST WEST OF AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY ON THE FLANK OF ONGOING ARKLATEX CONVECTION. AS MAY ALREADY BE TAKING PLACING NEAR THE WATONGA VICINITY /1900Z/...CURRENT THINKING IS THAT SURFACE BASED CONVECTION MAY BECOME INCREASINGLY PREVALENT WITHIN THE MOIST /GENERALLY NEAR 70S F SURFACE DEWPOINTS/ AND UNSTABLE AIRMASS TO THE EAST-SOUTHEAST OF THE AFOREMENTIONED WEAK MID-LEVEL IMPULSE AND ESPECIALLY NEAR RESIDUAL OUTFLOW. CONTEMPORARY MODIFICATIONS TO THE 12Z OBSERVED SOUNDING FROM NORMAN...IN CONJUNCTION WITH LATEST SPC OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS DATA...SUGGEST THAT NEGLIGIBLE BOUNDARY LAYER INHIBITION NOW EXISTS IN THE PRESENCE OF 2500 TO PERHAPS 3000 J/KG OF MLCAPE. THE LOWER TO MIDDLE TROPOSPHERIC WIND FIELD IS RELATIVELY WEAK BENEATH STRONG HIGH-LEVEL WESTERLIES...BUT AROUND 30 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK /STRONGEST TIED TO THE MID-LEVEL IMPULSE/ WILL ALLOW FOR SUSTAINED MULTICELLS/PERHAPS SOME TRANSIENT SUPERCELLS GIVEN THE DEGREE OF INSTABILITY. AS STORMS MATURE...RELATIVELY MOIST AIRMASS/POTENTIAL FOR WATER LOADING AND STEEP LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL ALLOW FOR DOWNBURSTS/LOCALIZED WIND DAMAGE ASIDE FROM PERIODIC BOUTS OF SEVERE HAIL. WHILE NOT CERTAIN...SOME HIGH-RES NUMERICAL GUIDANCE S

mesoscale_discussions.summary: HIGH BASED THUNDERSTORMS WILL SPREAD EWD ACROSS ERN CO THIS AFTERNOON INTO WRN KS AND EXTREME SWRN NEB. DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREAT. TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED FOR A WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 1915Z...REGIONAL RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED CLUSTERS OF HIGH BASED THUNDERSTORMS SPREADING EWD OFF THE FRONT RANGE IN CO. AIRMASS DOWNSTREAM FROM THIS ACTIVITY OVER ERN CO INTO WRN KS AND EXTREME SWRN NEB IS CHARACTERIZED BY TEMPERATURES IN THE 80S...DEWPOINTS RANGING FROM THE MID 40S TO MID 50S...AND STEEP 0-3 KM LAPSE RATES. MODEST WLY FLOW ALOFT WILL FAVOR A CONTINUED EWD MOVEMENT OF STORMS OVER THE HIGH PLAINS...AND GIVEN THE WELL MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER...DAMAGING DOWNBURSTS/OUTFLOW WINDS WILL BE POSSIBLE. VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY ALSO SHOWS AN AREA OF ENHANCED/AGITATED CUMULUS FORMING OVER W-CNTRL KS...WHICH MAY SIGNAL ANOTHER AREA OF POSSIBLE THUNDERSTORM INITIATION DURING THE NEXT HOUR OR SO. THIS ACTIVITY WOULD ALSO POSE A DAMAGING WIND THREAT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE TSTM POTENTIAL...AT LEAST ON A CONDITIONAL/ISOLATED BASIS...MAY INCREASE THROUGH LATE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING. A WATCH IS NOT IMMINENT/CERTAIN IN THE SHORT-TERM...BUT CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A FEW TOWERING CU ARE NOTED IN VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY ACROSS THE TX PANHANDLE/EASTERN OK PANHANDLE...INCLUDING AN INCIPIENT TSTM IN POTTER COUNTY TX. THIS ACTIVITY APPEARS TO BE IN THE WAKE OF A SUBTLE MID-LEVEL IMPULSE MOVING INTO WESTERN OK...WITH A BIT OF SUBSIDENCE POSSIBLE IN ITS WAKE. REGARDLESS...ASIDE FROM STRONG HEATING...LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE MAY BE MODESTLY INCREASING IN VICINITY OF A HIGH PLAINS SURFACE LOW ACROSS PARTS OF THE PANHANDLES...AND IN VICINITY OF AN ARCING REMNANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARY/CORRIDOR OF DIFFERENTIAL HEATING FROM THE NORTHERN/EASTERN TX PANHANDLE INTO THE EAST-CENTRAL OK PANHANDLE. WHILE THE AFOREMENTIONED CORRIDOR IS NOW MODERATELY UNSTABLE/WEAKLY CAPPED WITH 2000+ J/KG MLCAPE...THE EXTENT/MAGNITUDE OF A SEVERE THREAT IS NOT CERTAIN IN THE SHORT-TERM. PENDING INCREASING SURFACE BASED DEVELOPMENT...VERTICAL SHEAR SHOULD BE SUFFICIENT FOR SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF SEVERE HAIL/WIND...IN ADDITION TO THE POSSIBILITY OF AN UPSTREAM MCS AT LEAST GRAZING PARTS OF THE REGION LATER TONIGHT. CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE WATCH.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: NUMEROUS THUNDERSTORM CLUSTERS WILL MERGE ACROSS THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS THIS EVENING. LARGE HAIL/WIND THREAT REMAIN ACROSS BOTH WW 316/317.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: NUMEROUS DISCRETE THUNDERSTORM STRUCTURES HAVE SLOWLY CONGEALED ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS FROM WRN NEB...SWD ALONG THE CO/KS BORDER. AT LEAST THREE LARGER COMPLEXES HAVE EVOLVED WITHIN WATCH 316/317 AND FURTHER UPWARD EVOLUTION IS EXPECTED INTO THE EVENING HOURS. WITH TIME ONE OR MORE LARGE MCS-TYPE FEATURES SHOULD EMERGE OVER THE HIGH PLAINS WITH SWD PROPAGATIONAL COMPONENT EXPECTED TO DRIVE ACTIVITY ACROSS WRN KS. IN THE SHORT TERM LARGE HAIL IS THE PRIMARY SEVERE THREAT...THOUGH DAMAGING WIND THREAT COULD INCREASE IF LARGER BOWING TYPE STRUCTURES EVOLVE. PORTIONS OF NORTH CENTRAL KS MAY NEED TO BE ADDED TO ONGOING WATCHES. ..DARROW.. 06/16/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED DMGG WIND/LARGE HAIL THREAT WILL PERSIST ACROSS WW 318...ESPECIALLY WITH DISCRETE STORMS ATTAINING BRIEF SUPERCELLULAR CHARACTERISTICS. A MORE WIDESPREAD THREAT WILL BE SOMEWHAT LIMITED IN THE SHORT TERM BY GENERAL LACK OF SUSTAINED TSTM ORGANIZATION AND THE OCCURRENCE OF NUMEROUS OUTFLOW INTERACTIONS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR/VISIBLE SATELLITE TRENDS SHOW ISOLATED STRONG-SVR STORMS MAINLY NEAR/N OF THE I-40/I-44 CORRIDORS. MUCH OF THIS ACTIVITY HAS BEEN FOCUSED ALONG PREEXISTING OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES. THE STRONGEST CLUSTERS OF STORMS...WHICH HAVE DISPLAYED SUPERCELLULAR CHARACTERISTICS AT TIMES...CURRENTLY ARE LOCATED OVER CADDO/GRADY COUNTIES IN W-CNTRL OK...NOBLE COUNTY IN N-CNTRL OK...AND WAGONER/MUSKOGEE COUNTIES IN ERN OK. CURRENT TRENDS SUGGEST THAT PROPAGATION/NEW CELL DEVELOPMENT APPEARS TO BE PREFERRED ALONG THE SWRN FLANK OF THESE TSTM CLUSTERS...WHICH SHOULD SUSTAIN CONVECTION ESPECIALLY IN AREAS WHERE THE ENVIRONMENT IS UNPERTURBED /E.G. SWRN OK/ AND MOST UNSTABLE /MLCAPE VALUES OF 2000-3000 J/KG/. NEW CELL DEVELOPMENT WILL CONTINUE TO LARGELY BE DRIVEN BY OUTFLOW/STORM-SCALE INTERACTIONS...WITH CONSOLIDATION OF ONE OR MORE SMALL LINES POSSIBLE INTO THE LATE EVENING. ..ROGERS.. 06/16/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH WILL LIKELY BE REQUIRED ACROSS PORTIONS OF KS INTO NWRN OK.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AN UPWARD EVOLVING CORRIDOR OF THUNDERSTORMS IS CURRENTLY LOCATED FROM SWRN KS INTO SCNTRL NEB. THIS ACTIVITY IS PROPAGATING SEWD INTO AN AIRMASS THAT REMAINS CONDUCIVE FOR MAINTENANCE OF ORGANIZED SEVERE. 00Z SOUNDING FROM DDC EXHIBITS STEEP LAPSE RATES WITH MODEST INSTABILITY AND SHEAR SUPPORTIVE OF ORGANIZED MULTI-CELL UPDRAFTS. LATEST RADAR DATA SUGGESTS SEVERAL MCV/S ARE DEVELOPING ALONG THE BAND OF CONVECTION...THE STRONGEST OF WHICH IS LOCATED NW OF GCK. WITH TIME A LARGER COMPLEX OF STORMS MAY EMERGE IN ASSOCIATION WITH THIS FEATURE WHICH SHOULD PROPAGATE EAST OF THE CURRENT SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH WITHIN THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS ARE POSSIBLE WITH THIS ACTIVITY.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LARGE MCS EVOLVING OVER KS SHOULD PROPAGATE SEWD INTO NRN OK AFTER MIDNIGHT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WELL FORMED MCV HAS DEVELOPED WITHIN EXPANDING PRECIP SHIELD JUST NE OF DDC. LEADING EDGE OF BOWING LINE IS PROGRESSING ESEWD AT ROUGHLY 40KT WITH TRAILING LINE SEGMENT ACROSS THE ERN OK PANHANDLE MOVING MORE SLOWLY SEWD AT ROUGHLY 30KT. GIVEN THIS SPEED IT APPEARS STRONG CONVECTION MAY APPROACH THE ERN SECTIONS OF WW319 OVER SCNTRL KS BY 0530Z. ADDITIONALLY...CNTRL PLAINS CONVECTION THAT EVOLVED OVER NEB CONTINUES TO PROPAGATE SSEWD AND THIS ACTIVITY IS EXPECTED TO CONSOLIDATE OVER CNTRL KS WITH AFOREMENTIONED MCS. LARGE COMPLEX OF STORMS SHOULD EVENTUALLY SPREAD INTO NRN/NERN OK AFTER MIDNIGHT. DAMAGING WINDS APPEAR TO BE THE PRIMARY SEVERE THREAT...THOUGH ISOLATED LARGE HAIL MAY ALSO ACCOMPANY THE STRONGEST CORES. ..DARROW.. 06/17/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN EXTENSIVE LINE OF THUNDERSTORMS WILL LIKELY CONTINUE TO POSE A DAMAGING WIND THREAT FROM SERN KS INTO MUCH OF OK AND PERHAPS NWRN TX LATER TONIGHT. ANOTHER WW MAY BE REQUIRED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A MOIST AND UNSTABLE AIR MASS REMAINS OVER THE REGION AHEAD OF THE ADVANCING MCS...ALTHOUGH RELATIVELY COOLER/MORE STABLE AIR RESIDES OVER NERN OK INTO SRN MO AND NRN AR. MEANWHILE...A SWLY LOW LEVEL JET OF 20-25 KT IS EXPECTED TO PERSIST...AND WITH NWLY FLOW ALOFT...THIS WILL FAVOR A CONTINUED FORWARD PROPAGATING SYSTEM CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WIND. GIVEN MODESTLY STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES...A FEW OF THE CORES WITHIN THE LINE MAY CONTAIN MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL AS WELL. ..JEWELL.. 06/17/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS WILL CONTINUE SEWD WITH MAINLY NON-SEVERE WIND GUSTS AND HEAVY RAIN.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TWO LINES OF STORMS ARE CURRENTLY MERGING ACROSS NWRN TX AND SWRN OK...WHERE INTERSECTING OUTFLOWS HAVE RESULTED IN A BRIEF INCREASE IN INTENSITY. HOWEVER...THE OUTFLOW FROM THE NRN LINE WILL CONTINUE TO SURGE AHEAD OF THE NWRN TX ACTIVITY AND WILL LIKELY LIMIT WIND GUST POTENTIAL THERE. RECENT OK MESONET OBSERVATIONS FURTHER SUGGEST STORMS ARE PRODUCING MAINLY 40-50 MPH WIND GUSTS. THIS GENERAL WEAKENING TREND IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE AS THE STORMS APPROACH THE RED RIVER AND ALSO MOVE INTO WRN AR WHERE INSTABILITY IS LESS. ..JEWELL.. 06/17/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...
